items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk Has Lost $650 Billion In 5 Weeks As Tesla And SpaceX Plummet
items.summary_cn: Musk 5周内个人财富蒸发6500亿美元，Tesla 与 SpaceX 估值大幅下挫，间接压制 SpaceX 相关持仓情绪。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Earnings at Musk's Tesla fall as spending on research cuts into profit from selling cars
items.summary_cn: Tesla 盈利下滑，研发开支侵蚀汽车销售利润，业绩面利空。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Want to Build Your Own Tesla Model S or X? Elon Musk Will Show You How.
items.summary_cn: Musk 称将展示如何自建 Tesla Model S/X，内容偏营销/技术分享，无直接多空信号。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Musk keeps Tesla-SpaceX merger speculation alive, cites growing overlap
items.summary_cn: Musk 重提 Tesla-SpaceX 合并猜测，称两者业务重叠加深，若合并将显著利好 SpaceX 相关持仓 SPCX/SPCH。

items.author: Musk
items.text: SpaceX and Tesla CEO Elon Musk Issues Stark 2036 Prediction That Could Be About To Blow Up The Bitcoin Price
items.summary_cn: Musk 发表2036年预测并称可能推动比特币价格走高，间接利好加密板块持仓 CRCL。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Reality Bites Elon Musk and His Tesla, SpaceX Believers
items.summary_cn: 媒体发文质疑 Musk 及 Tesla、SpaceX 信仰者，舆论面利空相关持仓。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk reflects on DOGE role: ‘I got carried away’
items.summary_cn: Musk 反思 DOGE 经历称'用力过猛'，对其参与的政府效率部门做阶段性回顾，间接影响 Musk 系叙事。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Should you be afraid of Elon Musk?
items.summary_cn: 媒体讨论是否应'害怕'Musk，舆论性文章，对 SpaceX 持仓情绪有间接影响。

items.author: Trump
items.text: The all Republican Senators! Terminate the Filibuster, which the Dumocrats will do as soon as they get the chance, and PASS THE SAVE AMERICA ACT, and everything else, including the Budget, and upcoming Debt Ceiling. Do it now, before it is too late!!! President DJT
items.summary_cn: Trump 呼吁共和党参议员终止阻挠议事、通过《拯救美国法案》及相关预算/债务上限法案，属国内政治立法层面，与市场间接相关。
